items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 5 at 7:09PM EDT until October 6 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...South Carolina Beaches, and Georgia Beaches.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High surf with breaking waves of 4 to 6
feet along the lower South Carolina coast and 5 to 7 feet along
the Georgia coast will occur. The combination of strong
northeast winds, elevated tides and large breaking waves will
increase the risk for significant beach erosion. A High Surf
Advisory may be issued for Tuesday and Tuesday night.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 5 at 7:12PM EDT until October 7 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and
seas 6 to 9 ft expected.

* WHERE...Edisto Beach to Savannah out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 5 AM Tuesday to 2 AM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
